Figure 3: Our method integrates large-scale grasp pretraining with a hierarchical policy framework. (a) A high-level sub-goal prediction policy takes the current point cloud observation as input and predicts the positions of hand key points. (b) A low-level policy is conditioned on predicted sub-goal key points and current observation and predicts action chunks for the controller. Top: We augment the Dexonomy [2] dataset into grasp trajectories and pretrain the low-level policy, which we fine-tune with data from the downstream task.
